sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (tenets 1-6). Binding architecture: flowspace3 crate-enforced hexagonal, functional core (fs3-architecture.md in the rust-port-handover packet) applied to pij, LAYOUT INCLUDED — Jordan likes fs3's file organization, so we mirror it: crates/ at repo root (one crate per responsibility), Cargo workspace at root, docs/rules-idioms-architecture/ for the promoted architecture doc. Boundaries are crates gated by a committed dependency allowlist with per-row rationale (negative-tested); core has no tokio/no IO; ports are minimal object-safe traits; adapters own wire quirks; daemon+cli are the only composition roots, in ONE binary; testkit ships fakes for every port, fake-as-default config, offline-first. Tier rule: pure logic->core, tmux IO->tmux, harness quirks->harnesses, persistence->store, wiring->daemon/cli. Queue-first daemon: a handler does one cheap statement, everything else is a job (enqueue+dedupe+serialized claims). INTERFACES BELOW ARE DRAFT until the plan-108 workshop ratifies them and the state-store ruling lands; then they are settled and changes are a prime ruling.

value.rationale: Wave 0 (the mold, plan 108) is one team solo per fs3 plan 001. Waves 1-4 fan out: units are SRP behind frozen port traits, each testable offline via testkit fakes; collision surfaces are crate-disjoint except the named seams (u-uds vs the s105 TS stream; u-models vs s106 semantics). Units cheaper than their own dispatch were folded (telegram/bg/chore -> u-sidecars).

value.name: core domain model
value.responsibility: Domain types + config + error taxonomy; pure logic only, no IO/tokio.
value.interface: pub struct SeatId(String); pub struct SeatDescriptor{id,harness,pane,pid,proc_start,folder,state,semantic_state,role,parent,..}; pub enum Harness{Claude,Copilot,Codex,Pi,Omp}; pub enum SystemState{Idle,Working} + SemanticState{Ready,Waiting,Hold,Blocked,Question,Done}; pub struct Envelope<T>{ok,command,v,data,meta}; PijError enum. Liveness identity = (pid, proc_start_time) NEVER pid alone (recycled-identifiers doctrine).
value.test_strategy: cargo test -p pij-core; zero doubles; serde round-trip + state-transition table tests.

value.name: registry + spine store
value.responsibility: Persistence behind ports: seat registry (single-writer rows), append-only spine (reports/events/receipts), baselines. Implements the plan-108 state-store ruling.
value.interface: trait Registry{get(&SeatId)->Option<SeatDescriptor>; put(desc)->Seq; list(filter)->Vec; tombstone(id,reason)}; trait Spine{append(Event)->Seq; tail(filter,since)->Vec<Event>}; single-writer enforced at store level, absent!=null distinguished in every read.
value.test_strategy: cargo test -p pij-store; FreshStore-per-test (entropy-named, destroyed after); crash-mid-write test.

value.name: job queue primitive
value.responsibility: Enqueue/claim/ack with dedupe (partial-unique over live jobs) and per-entity serialization. THE primitive delivery rides on — built before any consumer (lynx decision #3).
value.interface: trait Queue{enqueue(Job)->JobId /*upsert-dedupe*/; claim(kinds,worker)->Option<Job>; ack(JobId,Outcome)}; serial_key(entity) claimed one-at-a-time; N rapid submits collapse to one row.
value.test_strategy: cargo test -p pij-store queue; contention test (parallel claimers, set-equality); mutation-check the dedupe.

value.name: delivery service
value.responsibility: send/inbox/receipts: route a message to a seat via the best transport, queue when busy/pre-bind (FIXES the vanishing pre-bind message), honest receipts (queued=reliable doctrine).
value.interface: trait Transport{can_deliver(&Seat)->bool; deliver(&Seat,Msg)->DeliveryOutcome}; DeliveryService{send(from,to,body)->Receipt{queued|delivered|held}; inbox(seat,wait)->Vec<Msg>}; every route logs msg-id+outcome (ermine handover gap #8).
value.test_strategy: core logic vs FakeTransport script (busy, pre-bind, dead); receipt-honesty decision-table test.

value.name: tmux adapter
value.responsibility: All tmux IO: panes, windows, send-keys, capture, typing-gate signal. Nothing else shells out to tmux.
value.interface: trait TmuxPort{list_panes()->Vec<Pane>; send_keys(PaneId,&str); capture(PaneId,lines)->String; kill(PaneId); new_window(Session,name,cwd)->Pane; user_typing(PaneId)->bool}
value.test_strategy: contract test over FakeTmux; real-adapter test subclassed to kill list_panes (never taps the live fleet — standing rule).

value.name: socket transport
value.responsibility: Claude UDS /tmp/cc-socks delivery + future named-pipe; implements Transport. FENCE WARNING: s105 stream owns the TS version — coordinate, never fork semantics.
value.interface: impl Transport for UdsTransport; attestation = sender's verified pid is a Claude session (never a wire field); keep tmux typing gate when tmux present (Jordan 2026-08-27).
value.test_strategy: contract test vs recorded socket fixture; held-for-approval decision-table.

value.name: harness adapters
value.responsibility: Per-harness detect/bind/readiness/canary/model-catalog quirks (claude, copilot, codex, pi/omp). Owns BUSY_RE-class drift in ONE place.
value.interface: trait HarnessPort{kind()->Harness; discover_session(pane)->Option<NativeId>; bind(desc)->BindHealth; readiness(pane)->Readiness; busy(pane)->bool; models()->Vec<ModelRow>}
value.test_strategy: contract tests over recorded pane fixtures per harness; readiness-anchor regression fixtures (footer not rotating placeholder — the codex never-bind class).

value.name: process liveness
value.responsibility: alive/dead verdicts from (pid, proc start time); the ONLY authority on recycled pids (revive-refusal class).
value.test_strategy: unit table: alive/dead/recycled/boot-reset; mutation-check the recycled branch.

value.name: watchdog service
value.responsibility: Supervision engine: eligibility (consults semanticState — fixes parked-state blindness), nudge scheduling, watcher fan-out. Pure logic over injected clock+store.
value.interface: WatchdogService{tick(now)->Vec<Nudge>}; eligible(seat) excludes waiting|hold|blocked|question; stale threshold configurable, never a hardcoded 60s (healthy-long-tool-call false-stall class).
value.test_strategy: decision-table over fake clock/store; injection proof: synthesize the exact false-stall regression.

value.name: anomaly detectors
value.responsibility: status-stale, delivered-unacked, unverified-done, inert-subscription… each detector names its observable, every computed signal has a consumer (computed-but-unconsulted doctrine).
value.interface: trait Detector{scan(&dyn Store)->Vec<Anomaly{kind,seat,remediation_line}>}; rows clearable/ackable (fixes forever-accumulating dead-dispatch rows).
value.test_strategy: per-detector fixture stores; control test proving a cleared row stays cleared.

value.name: orchestration service
value.responsibility: Batons, projects/streams/ordinals, roles+prime designation, dispatch/ack, capability gate (PA read-only at ONE chokepoint).
value.interface: OrchestrationService over Registry+Spine; ordinal mint scans clone+worktrees+branch-heads (team-new race); stream create must NOT require a clean source tree (E-NOREG defect, ruled fix-in-port).
value.test_strategy: lease single-holder property test; ordinal-race test across fixture worktrees.

value.name: report + cards
value.responsibility: report now/state, card freshness, the 280-char limit as a documented error-early contract; stale-card stderr warning.
value.interface: ReportService{now(did,next)->Seq; state(kind,note); card(seat)->Card{age,..}}; limits in one const, the error names the limit.
value.test_strategy: boundary tests at 279/280/281 post-collapse; staleness clock tests.

value.name: model catalog
value.responsibility: Catalog assembly from harness adapters; runtime/provider/selector separation exactly per s106 semantics (landed f53a9fde) — behavior-preserving port.
value.interface: ModelCatalog{list(filter)->Vec<ModelRow{runtime,provider,selector,request_model_id,thinking:Option<Vec<Effort>>}>}; whole-inventory fail on malformed rows; null thinking = valid no-levels.
value.test_strategy: golden against TS `pij models --json` (parity tripwire); malformed-row rejection set-equality.

value.name: daemon HTTP + events
value.responsibility: Server: routes do one cheap statement or enqueue; auth middleware over the whole router; NDJSON event stream with Hello line + Unknown variant.
value.interface: POST /v1/send, GET /v1/seats, GET /v1/events (NDJSON), GET /health; per-boot bearer key 0600 before bind; envelope{ok,command,v:1,data,meta}.
value.test_strategy: route tests over fake services; 401+next_action test; Unknown-variant forward-compat test.

value.name: daemon lifecycle
value.responsibility: Single-instance guard, tick loop, graceful restart/upgrade (BETTER than fs3's tmux-pane admission), C6 restart-rule affordance.
value.interface: port-bind failure = second-daemon guard day 1; the supervise/upgrade DESIGN DOC is a deliverable even where impl phases.
value.test_strategy: boot/shutdown integration test; two-daemon refusal test.

value.name: CLI verb surface
value.responsibility: clap verbs -> DaemonClient -> rendering; human + --json faces; stale-CLI/new-daemon guarded by envelope v (one binary, versions together).
value.interface: each verb = thin fn(client,args)->Envelope + render; goldens frozen for COMPUTED payloads only (editorial content gets shape assertions).
value.test_strategy: byte-goldens vs TS binary; clap surface snapshot; exit-code contract table.

value.name: telegram + bg + chore
value.responsibility: Telegram bridge, pij bg runner, chore probes/baselines — job consumers over existing ports; identity DERIVED via whoami, never asserted from env (seat-asserted-not-derived doctrine).
value.interface: each sidecar = a queue consumer + a port; chore run NEVER advances a baseline, only ack does.
value.test_strategy: fixture-driven consumer tests; chore run/ack asymmetry decision-table.

value.note: Worktree+branch per coder off the PM plan branch; PM merges, coders never merge. Rust-specific: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 fleet-wide, per-seat CARGO_TARGET_DIR, Avail disk in every done report ('rustc-LLVM ERROR: IO failure' = full disk wearing a compiler costume). Absolute paths in every packet.

value.steps: PM composes per wave in dependency order (0 mold -> 1 store/tmux/liveness -> 2 services -> 3 surfaces -> 4 sidecars); composition is wiring not building; assumptions section demanded in every done report; unit rework at compose = a phase-1 contract defect, recorded not patched; when main moves under a fan-out, merge main IMMEDIATELY; first light = one real end-to-end transcript (spawn a real seat, send, receive).
value.integration_proof: First light per wave: one real end-to-end transcript on the composed tree — wave 1: registry round-trip through a real store file/db; wave 2: a message enqueued, claimed, delivered to a FakeTmux pane with an honest receipt; wave 3: pij-rs spawn/send/tail against a REAL tmux session + one byte-golden parity diff vs the TS CLI on the same store; wave 4: a chore run/ack cycle through the queue. Recorded as a transcript artifact in the plan assets, not an exit code.

value.when: after each wave composition, before the PR into the plan branch/main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps. Done gate: fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, full tests, drift allowlist, prove-in-tree evidence, mutation-check on fix-tests. Parity: byte-goldens vs the TS CLI for computed payloads.

value.text: Interfaces are pre-workshop drafts — settling them IS plan 108's job; never dispatch waves 1+ against unratified traits. Check: workshop ratification recorded before any wave-1 packet.
State-store ruling unmade; u-store/u-queue signatures shift with it. Check: ruling recorded in plan 108 workshop before wave 1.
TS defect list (lynx's 8 + ermine's handover) needs per-item fix-vs-bug-compatible rulings BEFORE the owning unit dispatches. Check: ruling table in the owning unit's packet.
Live TS daemon keeps evolving (s105 socket, daemon perf). Check: byte-goldens as drift tripwire + PM merges main immediately when it moves.
Cutover risk deferred to its own plan behind the parity harness. Check: no TS retirement step exists in any wave.
